environment.description: Same Node.js 18 application deployed inside a pivot_root(2) jail established by a custom init process before the Node runtime starts. The new root is set to /srv/jail which contains only: /srv/jail/tmp/uploads (writable, tmpfs 512MB, nosuid,nodev,noexec), /srv/jail/app (read-only bind mount of application code), /srv/jail/usr/lib and /srv/jail/usr/bin (read-only, minimal node binary and shared libs). The old root is unmounted entirely via MNT_DETACH before execve of node. Additionally, the process has PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS and a seccomp-bpf filter that blocks symlink/symlinkat/link/linkat syscalls (SCMP_ACT_ERRNO). The /tmp/uploads tmpfs is mounted with a 512MB size limit preventing disk exhaustion. There are no files containing credentials, keys, or sensitive data anywhere within the jail filesystem tree.

config.jail_type: pivot_root with old root MNT_DETACH unmounted
config.old_root: fully unmounted via MNT_DETACH before node starts
